summary: Custom filter plugins go in a filter_plugins directory next to the play, inside a role or in a filter plugin path configured in ansible.cfg.
questions: Where do I put a custom Jinja filter for my playbooks?
Can a role bundle its own filters?

answer_card.title: Adding a custom filter plugin
answer_card.answer_md: Place it in a `filter_plugins` directory next to your play, inside a role, or in a filter plugin directory configured in `ansible.cfg`.
